verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list Anthropic Messages API support alongside its OpenAI-compatible server, which directly covers calling the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint. The evidence is only a one-line feature-list claim. Missing for 10: detailed endpoint documentation (route, supported request fields, streaming/tool-use parity), and independent or hands-on corroboration that Anthropic clients work against it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint
